Just remember this. Politics is about coming up with an answer for questions that don't have a right answer. There is no permanent solution on the political spectrum. There's no point in any ideology where you can become set in your ways and expect never to have your beliefs challenged.

Horseshoe politics is real because political extremes are easy to comprehend and primarily based on emotion. Focus instead on developing your personal philosophy and then embrace whatever solutions will most realistically lead to realizing that philosophy.

To piggyback on what other are saying about emotion vs being rational, I think it's important to understand and keep in mind that sometimes you aren't going to just feel one, definite way about something and that's Your Opinion.

Sometimes, you're going to realize that you don't really give a shit about certain extremist suggestions because they don't effect you in the slightest. Sometimes you're going to harbor secret glee over the idea of all your opponents getting their ass handed to them. That's okay. You're human, and that's totally normal.

The important thing, though, is to realize when these "solutions" aren't feasible, would open a can of worms, or aren't in line with your other principles. You should then try to think of a good resolution that is feasible, in line with your principles, etc.
